subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: When one Antigravity quota family is exhausted but another remains usable, should automatic menu-bar and Overview highest-usage selection surface the exhausted family, preserve the usable family, or use context-specific rules?
rationale: Current main has a test-backed usable-lane fallback, while this PR intentionally reverses that default across two user-visible consumers; source review cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Use context-specific semantics
options.body: Show the actionable exhausted reset in reset-oriented display while preserving a usable lane for percentage and highest-usage contexts, with focused tests for both consumers.

options.title: Prioritize exhaustion everywhere
options.body: Adopt this PR's shared most-constrained rule so any recognized exhausted family wins automatic display and provider ranking.

options.title: Preserve current fallback
options.body: Keep skipping exhausted families while another family remains usable and limit the PR to cadence recognition and reset tie-breaking fixes.

recommendation.title: Use context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Show the actionable exhausted reset in reset-oriented display while preserving a usable lane for percentage and highest-usage contexts, with focused tests for both consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: He most recently finalized and merged the Antigravity quota-window projection and is the repository owner named in the product-policy discussion.
